description: Pure C# service that recognises Notion-style markdown shortcut patterns typed at the beginning of a block line. Invoke after the user presses Space or Enter. The argument must be the full plain-text content of the current block (including the trigger character that was just appended). Pattern table (most-specific first to avoid prefix collisions): PatternBlock type ### (Space)Heading3 ## (Space)Heading2 # (Space)Heading1 * (Space) or - (Space)BulletList 1. (Space)NumberedList [x] (Space)TodoItem (checked) [] (Space)TodoItem (unchecked) > (Space)Quote ``` (Enter or standalone)Code --- (Enter or standalone)Divider

members.name: Detect
members.description: Analyses and returns the conversion suggestion, or null when no known shortcut is recognised.

members.name: FromJsShortcutKey
members.description: Converts the shortcut string emitted by notion-editor.js (e.g. "heading1", "bullet") into the corresponding , or null when the string is unrecognised. This bridges the existing JS-side detection with the C# type system.

members.name: IsCheckedTodo
members.description: Returns true if represents a checked todo shortcut ("todo_checked" / "[x] " pattern).
